posts.title: Once you get to 'Principal Engineer' level.. there is no 'going back'.

posts.title: Alternative Backup Situation Implemented
posts.description: Backups should be future-proof. Very happy to report that my ‘backup box’ has successfully transferred the whole 2.4TB borg backup archive of the crucial files on my homelab server and entire home network, after it was deduped and encrypted, over rsync over the electric circuit in my rented house via powerline adaptors.
